dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to create a webcast in order to provide communities access to information concerning climate change and responses, improving information-sharing and communication. The webcasts were designed to focus on the four main themes in the T'Sou-ke First Nation climate change adaptation strategy (food security, energy security, economic security, and cultural renaissance).
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Information sharing

dct_title_s: T'Sou-ke First Nation Proposal for CIER/T'Sou-ke Partnership
